item.title: Big Japan Emitters Buy Carbon Credits Ahead of Compliance Market
item.description: Large Japanese polluters are buying carbon credits on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Inc.’s voluntary market ahead of the launch of the nation’s mandatory scheme, according to an official with the bourse.

item.title: Big Tech to Spend $650 Billion This Year as AI Race Intensifies
item.description: Four of the biggest US technology companies together have forecast capital expenditures that will reach about $650 billion in 2026 — a mind-boggling tide of cash earmarked for new data centers and the long list of equipment needed to make them tick, including artificial intelligence chips, networking cables and backup generators.

item.title: Copper Extends Retreat as Focus Turns Back to Soft Fundamentals
item.description: Copper extended its retreat from a record high reached last week as the focus turned back to softening demand following a speculative buying frenzy that saw prices break free from fundamentals.

item.title: I Squared Said to Weigh Sale of $2 Billion Data Center Firm BDx
item.description: I Squared Capital is considering options for its Asian data center business BDx, including a sale, people familiar with the matter said, signaling another potential deal in an industry riding the artificial intelligence boom.

item.title: India’s Reliance Buys First Venezuelan Oil Cargo Since Mid-2025
item.description: Reliance Industries Ltd. has returned to Venezuelan crude after a pause that began in the middle of last year, as India seeks to diversify its supply and US intervention brings the South American country’s oil back to market.
